settings.usp_title: Dedicated Support, Exclusive Products, and Financing
settings.usp_content: Our Partner+ program is engineered to support the business needs of home renovation experts, contractors, and interior designers. Benefits include dedicated support, access to exclusive, members-only products, project financing, and more.
Secure exclusive pricing on all your purchases and no order minimums as a token of our dedication to your business growth and partnership with Flooret.

Featuring a comprehensive range of cut and full plank samples, it’s an essential tool for developing client proposals and conveying design concepts effectively. Samples are completely free, ensuring you have the necessary resources for your client-focused projects.
In addition to free samples of individual planks, you can also order convenient Sample Kits to try out countless possibilities, all at no cost to you.

settings.heading: Exclusive Pricing, Free Samples, & More
settings.content: Our Partner+ program offers exclusive Trade Pricing on all Flooret products, free flooring samples shipped fast, flexible financing options, and so much more.
